items.titolo: OpenAI Is Pissing Off a Bunch of Mathematicians—Again
items.descrizione: “There’s a perception of mobster behavior” from leading AI companies, one mathematician tells WIRED as OpenAI prepares to release more than 100 new solutions to unsolved problems.

items.titolo: Microsoft’s new Copilot app puts everything in one place – but the price is ‘evolving’
items.descrizione: Microsoft says Copilot has gotten ‘actually really good.’ The new app has AI agents and can write code. So how much is all this going to cost?

items.titolo: Use Gemini for free? You’ll soon be limited to its weakest AI model
items.descrizione: Google is cutting off free users from the Flash and Pro models. AI Plus subscribers are losing out too

items.titolo: Mistral Says Its New AI Model ‘Le Chonk’ Is the Best Open-Weight Offering Outside of China
items.descrizione: With the release of its new trillion-parameter model, Mistral is hoping to demonstrate it’s “still in the race” to build frontier-level artificial intelligence.
